Package CPDFGeneration

Class CEmailFlags

java.lang.Object
CPDFGeneration.CEmailFlags
public final class CEmailFlags extends Object
Rendering and export flags combined with bitwise OR in CEmailOptions.flags. Unknown bits are rejected with CEmailStatus.EMAIL_ERROR_INVALID_PARAMETER.
Since:
1.3.0
